source: Build up a food surplus instead of eating hand to mouth. Harvest carrots, potatoes, beetroot and sweet berries whenever they are in reach, and hunt nearby animals when the meat supply is short.
Cook raw meat at a furnace before storing it, and bank the surplus in the base chests so there is always food to come home to.

Being unarmed is never a reason to stop feeding yourself. Foraging, baking, cooking and going out to look for food all happen whether or not there is a weapon in the bag -- an agent that cannot get wood must still be able to eat.

A base in a barren area starves you slowly. When no berry bushes, crops or animals live within reach of the base, ranging out to find them IS the job: explore until you find a berry patch, a herd, or ground fit for a farm, !rememberHere the spot, and haul the harvest home. If you ever hold seeds, till ground near water at the base and plant them -- a farm is the only food source that comes to you.
goal: Keep a standing food surplus in the base chests: farm, forage and hunt for it rather than waiting until you are hungry, and when nothing edible lives within reach of the base, go find where it does live, remember the spot, and bring the food home -- as harvest, as seeds for a farm, or as animals worth returning to.

rules.name: forage_carrots
rules.description: Carrots in reach are free food. Take them.

rules.name: forage_potatoes
rules.description: Potatoes in reach are free food. Take them.

rules.name: forage_berries
rules.description: Berry bushes restock themselves, so pick them every time you pass one.

rules.name: harvest_wheat_for_bread
rules.description: Wheat is not edible on its own -- it is bread once there are three of them.

rules.name: bake_bread
rules.description: Wheat is worth more as bread. Named action, not a prompt: nothing here needs deciding.

rules.name: cook_raw_meat
rules.description: Raw meat feeds half as well and can poison you. A smelt step per meat: each one is a no-op if you have none of it, which is cheaper than one LLM turn asking which you have.

rules.name: build_a_furnace_for_cooking
rules.description: No furnace in reach and cobblestone in the bag: make one and put it down where you stand. Two named actions -- the LLM turn this replaced only ever said the same two things.

rules.name: stock_the_pantry
rules.description: Bank the harvest at the base and keep a working supply on hand. Triggered by a surplus of any staple, not only carrots -- a bot that farms potatoes all day should not need a carrot glut before it banks anything. Extra deposits are cheap no-ops when the item is absent.

rules.name: berry_run_while_stocked_low
rules.description: The gathering half of the profile, not the starving half: when berry stock is low, go walk the search radius for a bush regardless of how full the hunger bar is. Every earlier rule here waited for hunger or for food to be within 24 blocks, so a bot in a sparse biome survived fine but never built the surplus this attribute exists for. Backoff idles it in biomes with no bushes at all.

rules.name: hunt_for_the_larder
rules.description: Meat stock low and game in sight: walk to it while things are calm, and the hunting mode does the killing once in range. Stock-gated, not hunger-gated -- hunting only when starving means hunting at night, hurt, and unarmed.

rules.name: search_out_berries
rules.description: Hungry with nothing edible carried and no bush in sight: walk the 128-block search radius for one instead of asking the LLM where food is. Berry bushes regrow, so every patch found once is food forever. A search that finds nothing reports no progress and the engine's backoff slows this rule down on its own.

rules.name: search_out_game
rules.description: Hungrier still, no berries found: walk to the nearest animal instead of prompting. The hunting mode does the killing once one is in range. Two searches, cheapest first -- a step that finds nothing returns false and the next one runs.

rules.name: go_find_food_when_none_in_reach
rules.description: The named searches above already walked the area for berries and game and came back empty, and hunger is now serious. Only judgment about what this biome offers can help, so this is the one place the profile pays for an LLM turn.

do.message: You are carrying no food at all and there is nothing to forage or hunt within reach. Do not wait for hunger to force this. Go and look, and pick what suits the land you are actually standing in rather than what you wish were here. In a snowy pine forest that means sweet berry bushes and rabbits, not cows and wheat fields. Try in this order: !searchForBlock sweet_berry_bush 128 and !collectBlocks them -- berry bushes regrow, so a patch you find once is food forever, and !rememberHere it. Otherwise !searchForEntity for whatever animal lives here -- rabbit, sheep, chicken, cow, pig, fox -- and !attack it, then !smeltItem the raw meat if a furnace is in reach. Bare hands are enough for any of those; they do not fight back. They are not enough for anything that does, so if you are unarmed do not let a hunt turn into a fight. If you have string from spiders, 3 sticks and 2 string make a fishing_rod and any open water is then food you can stand still for. Finish one of these before starting anything else, and if a search says it could not travel at all, move somewhere else first -- searching again from a spot you cannot leave will not work.
